welcome: You are in an open field west of a big white house, with a boarded front door.
help: DM `new game` to start. Try: look, n/s/e/w, open, take, inventory, examine, light, move, attack, put, help, ?. `1/3…` = more coming, wait · `.3/3` = done.

alice.name: Tea Room
alice.description: You are in a small square room, in the center of which is a large oblong table, no doubt set for afternoon tea. It is clear from the objects on the table that the users were indeed mad. In the eastern corner of the room is a small hole (no more that four inches high). There are passageways leading away to the west and the northwest.

east.nexit: Only a mouse could get in there.

alism.name: Posts Room
alism.description: You are in an enormous room, in the center of which are four wooden posts delineating a rectanular area, above which is what appears to be a wooden roof. In fact, all objects in this room appear to be abnormally large. To the east is a passageway. There is a large chasm on the west and the northwest.

northwest.nexit: There is a chasm too large to jump across.

west.nexit: There is a chasm too large to jump across.

down.nexit: There is a chasm too large to jump across.

alitr.name: Pool Room
alitr.description: You are in a large room, one half of which is depressed. There is a large leak in the ceiling through which brown colored goop is falling. The only exit to this room is to the west.

atlan.name: Atlantis Room
atlan.description: You are in an ancient room, long buried by the Reservoir. There are exits here to the southeast and upward.

attic.name: Attic
attic.description: You are in the attic. The only exit is stairs that lead down.

barre.name: Barrel
barre.description: You are in a barrel. Congratulations. Etched into the side of the barrel is the word 'Geronimo!'.

bats.name: Bat Room
bats.description: You are in a small room which has only one door, to the east.

beach.name: Sandy Beach
beach.description: You are on a large sandy beach at the shore of the river, which is flowing quickly by. A path runs beside the river to the south here.

bladd.name: Ladder Bottom
bladd.description: You are in a rather wide room. On one side is the bottom of a narrow wooden ladder. To the northeast and the south are passages leaving the room.

blroo.name: Strange Passage
blroo.description: You are in a long passage. To the south is one entrance. On the east there is an old wooden door, with a large hole in it (about cyclops sized).

boom.name: Gas Room
boom.description: You are in a small room which smells strongly of coal gas.

bshaf.name: Lower Shaft
bshaf.description: You are in a small square room which is at the bottom of a long shaft. To the east is a passageway and to the northeast a very narrow passage. In the shaft can be seen a heavy iron chain.

cexit.fail: You cannot fit through this passage with that load.
You cannot fit through this passage with that load.

bwell.name: Circular Room
bwell.description: You are in a damp circular room, whose walls are made of brick and mortar. The roof of this room is not visible, but there appear to be some etchings on the walls. There is a passageway to the west.

caged.name: Cage
caged.description: You are trapped inside an iron cage.

cager.name: Dingy Closet
cager.description: You are in a dingy closet adjacent to the machine room. On one wall is a small sticker which says Protected by FROBOZZ Magic Alarm Company (Hello, footpad!)

cany1.name: Deep Canyon
cany1.description: You are on the south edge of a deep canyon. Passages lead off to the east, south, and northwest. You can hear the sound of flowing water below.

carou.name: Round room
carou.description: You are in a circular room with passages off in eight directions. Your compass needle spins wildly, and you can't get your bearings.

cave1.name: Cave
cave1.description: You are in a small cave with an entrance to the north and a stairway leading down.

cave2.name: Cave
cave2.description: You are in a tiny cave with entrances west and north, and a dark, forbidding staircase leading down.

cave3.name: Damp Cave
cave3.description: You are in a cave. Passages exit to the south and to the east, but the cave narrows to a crack to the west. The earth is particularly damp here.

west.nexit: It is too narrow for most insects.

cave4.name: Engravings Cave
cave4.description: You have entered a cave with passages leading north and southeast.

cella.name: Cellar
cella.description: You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading east, and a crawlway to the south. On the west is the bottom of a steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.

cexit.fail: The trap door has been barred from the other side.

west.nexit: You try to ascend the ramp, but it is impossible, and you slide back down.

chas1.name: Chasm
chas1.description: A chasm runs southwest to northeast. You are on the south edge; the path exits to the south and to the east.

down.nexit: Are you out of your mind?

chas2.name: West of Chasm
chas2.description: You are on the west edge of a chasm, the bottom of which cannot be seen. The east side is sheer rock, providing no exits. A narrow passage goes west, and the path you are on continues to the north and south.

down.nexit: The chasm probably leads straight to the infernal regions.

chas3.name: Ancient Chasm
chas3.description: A chasm, evidently produced by an ancient river, runs through the cave here. Passages lead off in all directions.

clbot.name: Canyon Bottom
clbot.description: You are beneath the walls of the river canyon which may be climbable here. There is a small stream here, which is the lesser part of the runoff of Aragain Falls. To the north is a narrow path.

clear.name: Clearing
clear.description: You are in a clearing, with a forest surrounding you on the west and south.

clmid.name: Rocky Ledge
clmid.description: You are on a ledge about halfway up the wall of the river canyon. You can see from here that the main flow from Aragain Falls twists along a passage which it is impossible to enter. Below you is the canyon bottom. Above you is more cliff, which still appears climbable.

cltop.name: Canyon View
cltop.description: You are at the top of the Great Canyon on its south wall. From here there is a marvelous view of the Canyon and parts of the Frigid River upstream. Across the canyon, the walls of the White Cliffs still appear to loom far above. Following the Canyon upstream (north and northwest), Aragain Falls may be seen, complete with rainbow. Fortunately, my vision is better than average and I can discern the top of the Flood Control Dam #3 far to the distant north. To the west and south can be seen an immense forest, stretching for miles around. It is possible to climb down into the canyon from here.

cmach.name: Machine Room
cmach.description: You are in a large room full of assorted heavy machinery. The room smells of burned resistors. The room is noisy from the whirring sounds of the machines. Along one wall of the room are three buttons which are, respectively, round, triangular, and square. Naturally, above these buttons are instructions written in EBCDIC. A large sign in English above all the buttons says 'DANGER -- HIGH VOLTAGE '. There are exits to the west and the south.

craw1.name: Rocky Crawl
craw1.description: You are in a crawlway with a three-foot high ceiling. Your footing is very unsure here due to the assortment of rocks underfoot. Passages can be seen in the east, west, and northwest corners of the passage.

craw2.name: Steep Crawlway
craw2.description: You are in a steep and narrow crawlway. There are two exits nearby to the south and southwest.

craw3.name: Narrow Crawlway
craw3.description: You are in a narrow crawlway. The crawlway leads from north to south. However the south passage divides to the south and southwest.

craw4.name: North-South Crawlway
craw4.description: You are in a north-south crawlway; a passage goes to the east also. There is a hole above, but it provides no opportunities for climbing.

up.nexit: Not even a human fly could get up it.

cyclo.name: Cyclops Room
cyclo.description: You are in a room with an exit on the west side, and a staircase leading up.

cexit.fail: The north wall is solid rock.
The cyclops doesn't look like he'll let you past.

dam.name: Dam
dam.description: You are standing on the top of the Flood Control Dam #3, which was quite a tourist attraction in times far distant. There are paths to the north, south, east, and down.

dock.name: Dam Base
dock.description: You are at the base of Flood Control Dam #3, which looms above you and to the north. The river Frigid is flowing by here. Across the river are the White Cliffs which seem to form a giant wall stretching from north to south along the east shore of the river as it winds its way downstream.

dome.name: Dome Room
dome.description: You are at the periphery of a large dome, which forms the ceiling of another room below. Protecting you from a precipitous drop is a wooden railing which circles the dome.

cexit.fail: You cannot go down without fracturing many bones.
You cannot go down without fracturing many bones.

echo.name: Loud Room
echo.description: You are in a large room with a ceiling which cannot be detected from the ground. There is a narrow passage from east to west and a stone stairway leading upward. The room is extremely noisy. In fact, it is difficult to hear yourself think.

egypt.name: Egyptian Room
egypt.description: You are in a room which looks like an Egyptian tomb. There is an ascending staircase in the room as well as doors, east and south.

cexit.fail: The passage is too narrow to accomodate coffins.

ehous.name: Behind House
ehous.description: You are behind the white house. In one corner of the house there is a small window which is slightly ajar.

entra.name: Mine Entrance
entra.description: You are standing at the entrance of what might have been a coal mine. To the northeast and the northwest are entrances to the mine, and there is another exit on the south end of the room.

falls.name: Aragain Falls
falls.description: You are at the top of Aragain Falls, an enormous waterfall with a drop of about 450 feet. The only path here is on the north end. There is a man-sized barrel here which you could fit into.

fante.name: Shore
fante.description: You are on the shore of the River. The river here seems somewhat treacherous. A path travels from north to south here, the south end quickly turning around a sharp corner.

fchmp.name: Moby lossage
fchmp.description: Oh dear, you seem to have gone over Aragain Falls. Not a very smart thing to do, apparently.

fore1.name: Forest
fore1.description: You are in a forest, with trees in all directions around you.

fore2.name: Forest
fore2.description: You are in a dimly lit forest, with large trees all around. To the east, there appears to be sunlight.

fore3.name: Forest
fore3.description: You are in a dimly lit forest, with large trees all around. To the east, there appears to be sunlight.

fore4.name: Forest
fore4.description: You are in a large forest, with trees obstructing all views except to the east, where a small clearing may be seen through the trees.

fore5.name: Forest
fore5.description: You are in a forest, with trees in all directions around you.

galle.name: Gallery
galle.description: You are in an art gallery. Most of the paintings which were here have been stolen by vandals with exceptional taste. The vandals left through either the north or south exits.

icy.name: Glacier Room
icy.description: You are in a large room, with giant icicles hanging from the walls and ceiling. There are passages to the north and east.

kitch.name: Kitchen
kitch.description: You are in the kitchen of the white house. A table seems to have been used recently for the preparation of food. A passage leads to the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward. To the east is a small window which is slightly ajar.

down.nexit: Only Santa Claus climbs down chimneys.

lava.name: Lava Room
lava.description: You are in a small room, whose walls are formed by an old lava flow. There are exits here to the west and the south.

ledg2.name: Narrow Ledge
ledg2.description: You are on a narrow ledge overlooking the inside of an old dormant volcano. This ledge appears to be about in the middle between the floor below and the rim above. There is an exit here to the south.

ledg3.name: Volcano View
ledg3.description: You are on a ledge in the middle of a large volcano. Below you the volcano bottom can be seen and above is the rim of the volcano. A couple of ledges can be seen on the other side of the volcano; it appears that this ledge is intermediate in elevation between those on the other side. The exit from this room is to the east.

cross.nexit: It is impossible to cross this distance.

ledg4.name: Wide Ledge
ledg4.description: You are on a wide ledge high into the volcano. The rim of the volcano is about 200 feet above and there is a precipitous drop below to the bottom.

libra.name: Library
libra.description: You are in a room which must have been a large library, probably for the royal family. All of the shelves appear to have been gnawed to pieces by unfriendly gnomes. To the north is an exit.

lld1.name: Entrance to Hades
lld1.description: You are outside a large gateway, on which is inscribed "Abandon every hope, all ye who enter here." The gate is open; through it you can see a desolation, with a pile of mangled corpses in one corner. Thousands of voices, lamenting some hideous fate, can be heard.

cexit.fail: Some invisible force prevents you from passing through the gate.
Some invisible force prevents you from passing through the gate.

lld2.name: Land of the Living Dead
lld2.description: You have entered the Land of the Living Dead, a large desolate room. Although it is apparently uninhabited, you can hear the sounds of thousands of lost souls weeping and moaning. In the east corner are stacked the remains of dozens of previous adventurers who were less fortunate than yourself. To the east is an ornate passage, apparently recently constructed.

lobby.name: Dam Lobby
lobby.description: This room appears to have been the waiting room for groups touring the dam. There are exits here to the north and east marked 'Private', though the doors are open, and an exit to the south.

lroom.name: Living Room
lroom.description: You are in the living room. There is a door to the east, a wooden door with strange gothic lettering to the west, which appears to be nailed shut, and a large oriental rug in the center of the room.

machi.name: Machine Room
machi.description: You are in a large room which seems to be air-conditioned. In one corner there is a machine (?) which is shaped somewhat like a clothes dryer. On the 'panel' there is a switch which is labelled in a dialect of Swahili. Fortunately, I know this dialect and the label translates to START. The switch does not appear to be manipulable by any human hand (unless the fingers are about 1/16 by 1/4 inch). On the front of the machine is a large lid.

magne.name: Low Room
magne.description: You are in a room with a low ceiling which is circular in shape. There are exits to the east and the southeast.

maint.name: Maintenance Room
maint.description: You are in what appears to have been the maintenance room for Flood Control Dam #3, judging by the assortment of tool chests around the room. Apparently, this room has been ransacked recently, for most of the valuable equipment is gone. On the wall in front of you is a panel of buttons, which are labelled in EBCDIC. However, they are of different colors: Blue, Yellow, Brown, and Red. The doors to this room are in the west and south ends.

maz10.name: You are in a maze of twisty little passages, all alike.
maz10.description: You are in a maze of twisty little passages, all alike.
maz10.brief: You are in a maze of twisty little passages, all alike.

mgrai.name: Grail Room
mgrai.description: You are standing in a small circular room with a pedestal. A set of stairs leads up, and passages leave to the east and west.

mgrat.name: Grating Room
mgrat.description: You are in a small room near the maze. There are twisty passages in the immediate vicinity.

mine1.name: You are in a non-descript part of a coal mine.
mine1.description: You are in a non-descript part of a coal mine.
mine1.brief: You are in a non-descript part of a coal mine.

mirr1.name: Mirror Room
mirr1.description: You are in a large square room with tall ceilings. On the south wall is an enormous mirror which fills the entire wall. There are exits on the other three sides of the room.

mirr2.name: Mirror Room
mirr2.description: You are in a large square room with tall ceilings. On the south wall is an enormous mirror which fills the entire wall. There are exits on the other three sides of the room.

mpear.name: Pearl Room
mpear.description: This is a former broom closet. The exits are to the east and west.

mtorc.name: Torch Room
mtorc.description: You are in a large room with a prominent doorway leading to a down staircase. To the west is a narrow twisting tunnel. Above you is a large dome painted with scenes depicting elfin hacking rites. Up around the edge of the dome (20 feet up) is a wooden railing. In the center of the room there is a white marble pedestal.

mtrol.name: The Troll Room
mtrol.description: You are in a small room with passages off in all directions. Bloodstains and deep scratches (perhaps made by an axe) mar the walls.

cexit.fail: The troll fends you off with a menacing gesture.
The troll fends you off with a menacing gesture.
The troll fends you off with a menacing gesture.

nhous.name: North of House
nhous.description: You are facing the north side of a white house. There is no door here, and all the windows are barred.

pass1.name: East-West Passage
pass1.description: You are in a narrow east-west passageway. There is a narrow stairway leading down at the north end of the room.

pass3.name: Cold Passage
pass3.description: You are in a cold and damp corridor where a long east-west passageway intersects with a northward path.

pass4.name: Winding Passage
pass4.description: You are in a winding passage. It seems that there is only an exit on the east end although the whirring from the round room can be heard faintly to the north.

north.nexit: You hear the whir of the carousel room but can find no entrance.

pass5.name: North-South Passage
pass5.description: You are in a high north-south passage, which forks to the northeast.

pog.name: End of Rainbow
pog.description: You are on a small beach on the continuation of the Frigid River past the Falls. The beach is narrow due to the presence of the White Cliffs. The river canyon opens here and sunlight shines in from above. A rainbow crosses over the falls to the west and a narrow path continues to the southeast.

rainb.name: Rainbow Room
rainb.description: You are on top of a rainbow (I bet you never thought you would walk on a rainbow), with a magnificent view of the Falls. The rainbow travels east-west here. There is an NBC Commissary here.

ravi1.name: Deep Ravine
ravi1.description: You are in a deep ravine at a crossing with an east-west crawlway. Some stone steps are at the south of the ravine and a steep staircase descends.

rcave.name: Rocky Shore
rcave.description: You are on the west shore of the river. An entrance to a cave is to the northwest. The shore is very rocky here.

resen.name: Reservoir North
resen.description: You are in the north end of a large cavernous room which was formerly a reservoir.

cexit.fail: You are not equipped for swimming.
You are not equipped for swimming.

reses.name: Reservoir South
reses.description: You are in the south end of a large cavernous room which was formerly a reservoir.

cexit.fail: The coffin will not fit through this passage.
You are not equipped for swimming.
You are not equipped for swimming.
The stairs are too steep for carrying the coffin.

riddl.name: Riddle Room
riddl.description: This is a room which is bare on all sides. There is an exit down. To the east is a great door made of stone. Above the stone, the following words are written: 'No man shall enter this room without solving this riddle: What is tall as a house, round as a cup, and all the king's horses can't draw it up?'

cexit.fail: Your way is blocked by an invisible force.

rivr1.name: Frigid River
rivr1.description: You are on the River Frigid in the vicinity of the Dam. The river flows quietly here. There is a landing on the west shore.

up.nexit: You cannot go upstream due to strong currents.

east.nexit: The White Cliffs prevent your landing here.

rivr2.name: Frigid River
rivr2.description: The River turns a corner here making it impossible to see the Dam. The White Cliffs loom on the east bank and large rocks prevent landing on the west.

up.nexit: You cannot go upstream due to strong currents.

east.nexit: The White Cliffs prevent your landing here.

rivr3.name: Frigid River
rivr3.description: The river descends here into a valley. There is a narrow beach on the east below the cliffs and there is some shore on the west which may be suitable. In the distance a faint rumbling can be heard.

up.nexit: You cannot go upstream due to strong currents.

land.nexit: You must specify which direction here.

rivr4.name: Frigid River
rivr4.description: The river is running faster here and the sound ahead appears to be that of rushing water. On the west shore is a sandy beach. A small area of beach can also be seen below the Cliffs.

up.nexit: You cannot go upstream due to strong currents.

rivr5.name: Frigid River
rivr5.description: The sound of rushing water is nearly unbearable here. On the west shore is a large landing area.

up.nexit: You cannot go upstream due to strong currents.

rubyr.name: Ruby Room
rubyr.description: You are in a small chamber behind the remains of the Great Glacier. To the south and west are small passageways.

safe.name: Dusty Room
safe.description: You are in a dusty old room which is virtually featureless, except for an exit on the north side.

shous.name: South of House
shous.description: You are facing the south side of a white house. There is no door here, and all the windows are barred.

slide.name: Slide Room
slide.description: You are in a small chamber, which appears to have been part of a coal mine. On the south wall of the chamber the letters "Granite Wall" are etched in the rock. To the east is a long passage and there is a steep metal slide twisting downward. From the appearance of the slide, an attempt to climb up it would be impossible. To the north is a small opening.

smell.name: Smelly Room
smell.description: You are in a small non-descript room. However, from the direction of a small descending staircase a foul odor can be detected. To the east is a narrow path.

squee.name: Squeaky Room
squee.description: You are a small room. Strange squeaky sounds may be heard coming from the passage at the west end. You may also escape to the south.

strea.name: Stream
strea.description: You are standing on a path beside a flowing stream. The path travels to the north and the east.

studi.name: Studio
studi.description: You are in what appears to have been an artist's studio. The walls and floors are splattered with paints of 69 different colors. Strangely enough, nothing of value is hanging here. At the north and northwest of the room are open doors (also covered with paint). An extremely dark and narrow chimney leads up from a fireplace; although you might be able to get up it, it seems unlikely you could get back down.

cexit.fail: The chimney is too narrow for you and all of your baggage.

tcave.name: Small Cave
tcave.description: You are in a small cave whose exits are on the south and northwest.

temp1.name: Temple
temp1.description: You are in the west end of a large temple. On the south wall is an ancient inscription, probably a prayer in a long-forgotten language. The north wall is solid granite. The entrance at the west end of the room is through huge marble pillars.

temp2.name: Altar
temp2.description: You are in the east end of a large temple. In front of you is what appears to be an altar.

timbe.name: Timber Room
timbe.description: You are in a long and narrow passage, which is cluttered with broken timbers. A wide passage comes from the north and turns at the southwest corner of the room into a very narrow passageway.

cexit.fail: You cannot fit through this passage with that load.

tladd.name: Ladder Top
tladd.description: You are in a very small room. In the corner is a rickety wooden ladder, leading downward. It might be safe to descend. There is also a staircase leading upward.

tomb.name: Tomb of the Unknown Implementer
tomb.description: You are in the Tomb of the Unknown Implementer. A hollow voice says: "That's not a bug, it's a feature!"

treas.name: Treasure Room
treas.description: This is a large room, whose north wall is solid granite. A number of discarded bags, which crumble at your touch, are scattered about on the floor.

tshaf.name: Shaft Room
tshaf.description: You are in a large room, in the middle of which is a small shaft descending through the floor into darkness below. To the west and the north are exits from this room. Constructed over the top of the shaft is a metal framework to which a heavy iron chain is attached.

down.nexit: You wouldn't fit and would die if you could.

tunne.name: Wooden Tunnel
tunne.description: You are in a narrow tunnel with large wooden beams running across the ceiling and around the walls. A path from the south splits into paths running west and northeast.

twell.name: Top of Well
twell.description: You are at the top of the well. Well done. There are etchings on the side of the well. There is a small crack across the floor at the entrance to a room on the east, but it can be crossed easily.

vair1.name: Volcano Core
vair1.description: You are about one hundred feet above the bottom of the volcano. The top of the volcano is clearly visible here.

vair2.name: Volcano Core
vair2.description: You are about two hundred feet above the volcano floor. Looming above is the rim of the volcano. There is a small ledge on the west side.

vair3.name: Volcano Core
vair3.description: You are high above the floor of the volcano. From here the rim of the volcano looks very narrow and you are very near it. To the east is what appears to be a viewing ledge, too thin to land on.

vair4.name: Volcano Core
vair4.description: You are near the rim of the volcano which is only about 15 feet across. To the west, there is a place to land on a wide ledge.

vlbot.name: Volcano Bottom
vlbot.description: You are at the bottom of a large dormant volcano. High above you light may be seen entering from the cone of the volcano. The only exit here is to the north.

wclf1.name: White Cliffs Beach
wclf1.description: You are on a narrow strip of beach which runs along the base of the White Cliffs. The only path here is a narrow one, heading south along the Cliffs.

wclf2.name: White Cliffs Beach
wclf2.description: You are on a rocky, narrow strip of beach beside the Cliffs. A narrow path leads north along the shore.

whous.name: West of House
whous.description: You are in an open field west of a big white house, with a boarded front door.

east.nexit: The door is locked, and there is evidently no key.

adver.name: leaflet
adver.description: There is a small leaflet here.
adver.readable: WELCOME TO DUNGEON DUNGEON is a game of adventure, danger, and low cunning. In it you will explore some of the most amazing territory ever seen by mortal man. Hardened adventurers have run screaming from the terrors contained within! In DUNGEON the intrepid explorer delves into the forgotten secrets of a lost labyrinth deep in the bowels of the earth, searching for vast treasures long hidden from prying eyes, treasures guarded by fearsome monsters and diabolical traps! No PDP-10 should be without one! DUNGEON was created at the Programming Technology Division of the MIT Laboratory for Computer Science, by Tim Anderson, Marc Blank, Bruce Daniels, and Dave Lebling. It was inspired by the ADVENTURE game of Crowther and Woods, and Dungeons and Dragons, by Gygax and Arneson. DUNGEON is written in MDL (alias MUDDLE). Direct inquiries by Net mail to DUNGEON@MIT-DMS.

axe.description: There is a bloody axe here.

bagco.description: An old leather bag, bulging with coins, is here.

ballo.name: basket
ballo.description: There is a very large and extremely heavy wicker basket with a cloth bag here. Inside the basket is a metal receptacle of some kind. Attached to the basket on the outside is a piece of wire.

book.name: book
book.description: On the altar is a large black book, open to page 569.
book.readable: COMMANDMENT #12592 Oh ye who go about saying unto each: "Hello sailor": dost thou know the magnitude of thy sin before the gods? Yea, verily, thou shalt be ground between two stones. Shall the angry gods cast thy body into the whirlpool? Surely, thy eye shall be put out with a sharp stick! Even unto the ends of the earth shalt thou wander and unto the land of the dead shalt thou be sent at last. Surely thou shalt repent of thy cunning.

engra.name: wall with engravings
engra.readable: The engravings were incised in the living rock of the cave wall by an unknown hand. They depict, in symbolic form, the beliefs of the ancient peoples of Zork. Skillfully interwoven with the bas reliefs are excerpts illustrating the major tenets expounded by the sacred texts of the religion of that time. Unfortunately a later age seems to have considered them blasphemous and just as skillfully excised them.

guide.name: tour guidebook
guide.description: Some guidebooks entitled 'Flood Control Dam #3' are on the reception desk.
guide.readable: "		 Guide Book to Flood Control Dam #3 Flood Control Dam #3 (FCD#3) was constructed in year 783 of the Great Underground Empire to harness the destructive power of the Frigid River. This work was supported by a grant of 37 million zorkmids from the Central Bureaucracy and your omnipotent local tyrant Lord Dimwit Flathead the Excessive. This impressive structure is composed of 3.7 cubic feet of concrete, is 256 feet tall at the center, and 193 feet wide at the top. The reservoir created behind the dam has a volume of 37 billion cubic feet, an area of 12 million square feet, and a shore line of 36 thousand feet. The construction of FCD#3 took 112 days from ground breaking to the dedication. It required a work force of 384 slaves, 34 slave drivers, 12 engineers, 2 turtle doves, and a partridge in a pear tree. The work was managed by a command team composed of 2345 bureaucrats, 2347 secretaries (at least two of which can type), 12,256 paper shufflers, 52,469 rubber stampers, 245,193 red tape processors, and nearly one million dead trees. We will now point out some of the more interesting features of FCD#3 as we conduct you on a guided tour of the facilities: 1) You start your tour here in the Dam Lobby. You will notice on your right that .........

match.name: matchbook
match.description: There is a matchbook whose cover says 'Visit Beautiful FCD#3' here.
match.readable: [close cover before striking BKD] You too can make BIG MONEY in the exciting field of PAPER SHUFFLING! Mr. TAA of Muddle, Mass. says: "Before I took this course I used to be a lowly bit twiddler. Now with what I learned at MIT Tech I feel really important and can obfuscate and confuse with the best." Mr. MARC had this to say: "Ten short days ago all I could look forward to was a dead-end job as a doctor. Now I have a promising future and make really big Zorkmids." MIT Tech can't promise these fantastic results to everyone. But when you earn your MDL degree from MIT Tech your future will be brighter. Send for our free brochure today.

paper.name: newspaper
paper.readable: US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT 12/12/77 				 Late Dungeon Edition In order to get a more-or-less working version, we have installed one with some known bugs. In particular, the following sequence will not work correctly, nor will anything resembling it: >take take what? >frob what do you want me to do with it? Note that if you now respond 'take', the right thing will happen. In short, the current parser can't handle verbs with missing objects. Since it is completely new, we'd appreciate reports of any other bugs encountered. FLASH! An important change has been made. When you have been killed, and the 'patch' question is asked, or if you are confirming a 'quit', it is now necessary to terminate the response to the question with a carriage return (you may be surprised to find that this wasn't true before). Also, the answer to the 'patch' question is taken to be yes unless something starting with n, N, f, or F is typed; the answer to the 'quit' question is no unless something starting with y, Y, t, or T is typed. FLASH! Another FLAG DAY has been declared for save files. Yes, ladies and gentlemen, yet another incompatible change has been made to the save/restore code. When will it end? Things like the bucket should resume working in this version. Many people have reported the following message: 'GIN FREE STORAGE- VECTOR ...GOUT TIME= n.nn' This indicates that a garbage collection is occurring. Some reports have this taking up to 30 sec. of cpu time, during which your dungeon will refuse to respond. We have added a feature which should prevent this; if you see such a message, please send mail to DUNGEON@DM describing the circumstances (particularly number of moves, save/restore status, and the TIME). A garbage collection is not fatal: your dungeon should be perfectly all right once it finishes (after the GOUT TIME= message is printed).

pearl.name: pearl necklace

pool.name: pool of sewage

pot.name: pot filled with gold
pot.description: At the end of the rainbow is a pot of gold.

praye.name: prayer
praye.description: The prayer is inscribed in an ancient script which is hardly remembered these days, much less understood. What little of it can be made out seems to be a phillipic against small insects, absent-minded
praye.readable: The prayer is inscribed in an ancient script which is hardly remembered these days, much less understood. What little of it can be made out seems to be a phillipic against small insects, absent-mindedness, and the picking up and dropping of small objects. The final verse seems to consign trespassers to the land of the dead. All evidence indicates that the beliefs of the ancient Zorkers were obscure.
